A LITTLE ABOUT US

OUR OVEN IS
ALWAYS ON.

Forno started with one simple thought: Dinga deserves a seriously good pizza.

So we make our dough fresh every morning, simmer our signature sauce in-house, and bake every order only when you ask for it. No shortcuts. No sad slices. Just proper pizza, made by people who care.

Fresh, never frozen

Dough made daily. Local produce. Real cheese.

Fire does the magic

A blazing-hot stone oven for that perfect crust.

Proudly local

Made in Dinga, for the people of Dinga.
